landing.lede: Vesteri brings order to what used to run on blind trust: the market, the developer, the lawyer, and the whole buying process. You make the decision. We make sure it is an informed one.

pillars.d: Developers vetted before you see a single listing.
Knows every project in depth and stays objective.
Law firms and due diligence with no conflict of interest.
Webinars with the developer: see the property and ask your questions live, without leaving home.

landing.closing: Vesteri brings a new dimension to international real estate. We combine smart technology with genuine human connection, making it easier to discover and buy property abroad, wherever you are.

process.title: From a local campaign to a warm investor on your desk

steps.d: We collect and organise your full investment documentation, then turn it into the knowledge base behind an AI chat. Investors get reliable answers in their own language, grounded solely in the developer's material.
We segment by what people actually do, not what they say.
Our moderator hosts the discussion. You present and answer questions live.
You receive an investor with a full intent profile and take the process from there, on your own or with our help.
We share contacts to verified law firms in the target market. That kind of backing earns investor trust.
Investors come back to future webinars for their next purchase, and they bring their friends.

You get demand, data, and direct contact with your clients. What you avoid is another salesperson standing between you and the buyer, juggling a portfolio of listings without deep knowledge of any of them.

tech.title: The webinar as a source of data, not an address list
tech.sub: At the heart of Vesteri sits our own webinar and AI platform, built around three things nobody else offers. Every campaign teaches the system a little more about what leads to a purchase.

cards.d: It answers investor questions on the spot, in their language. It knows every project in the portfolio in depth, works during the webinar, and keeps working long after. You never explain the same thing for the twentieth time, and you never worry that an agent forgot a detail or simply did not know it.
The platform records which project holds a participant's attention, what they ask, what they skip, and when they leave. A single meeting produces a profile of real interest.
The system rates how ready each participant is to buy and passes on only those who clear the qualification bar, together with a full record of their questions and interests.

cta.title: We deliver demand, data, and direct contact with your clients, with no middlemen. Sales stay on your side, and we stand ready to help whenever you need us. You are not alone.
cta.sub: Are you a developer in Cyprus, Spain, Greece or Portugal — or somewhere else? Let's talk about access to international capital!

meta.title: VESTERI — About us
meta.description: Vesteri is a brand of Time2Show, Inc., a Polish-American startup. For the past few years we have been building technology for the property industry.

who.heading: Who we are
paragraphs: Vesteri is a brand of Time2Show, Inc., a Polish-American startup. For the past few years we have been building technology for the property industry. It started with tools for online presentations and webinars, used by agencies and individual agents. Then came AI, which helps investors and brokerages save time and get information they can rely on. That side of our work runs under the Estalara name.

We built the team from people who have done this before. Engineers with years behind them in software, salespeople who have sold across borders, and licensed real estate agents. The agents keep the rest of us honest about how this market actually works and what the people in it need.

members.name: Piotr Nawrocki
members.bio: Twenty years in international sales for global corporations. An enthusiast of AI and new technology. He believes that business built to last rests on honest relationships rather than on the offer itself. People buy from people, not from companies.

members.name: Rafał Palak
members.bio: PhD and lecturer in applied computer science at Wrocław University of Science and Technology. Years of research work and hands-on experience building analytical systems, databases and AI models. He is the reason our products do exactly what we say they do.

members.name: Krzysztof Świętek
members.bio: Twenty years of organising concerts and large events, a school of planning with no room for improvisation on opening night. A superb organiser. For several years now he has followed the property market closely and worked in it, learning the trade from the inside. Today, as a licensed real-estate broker, he is our compass. When a product discussion drifts too far from practice, he brings us back down to earth.

why.heading: Why we are building Vesteri
paragraphs: Real estate is not short of technology. It is short of new questions. The industry keeps refining the same old answers — better listings, better filters, better photos — while the buyer has quietly changed. A generation that runs its whole life through a screen, compares everything, verifies everything, and expects to see before it believes, is still being asked to buy property the way their parents did: from a handful of photos and an assurance that everything is fine.

Nowhere is the gap wider than in cross-border deals. Communication breaks down, processes drag on for weeks, and information arrives incomplete or quietly left out. Someone buying from another country makes one of the biggest financial decisions of their life with less transparency than they get when ordering a pair of shoes online.

This is not to say the in-person visit stopped mattering. Sooner or later you have to see a property with your own eyes — and that moment is not going anywhere. What changed is everything before it: today's buyer wants to reach that moment online. Get to know the market, check out the agent, tour the property live, ask questions, and narrow the choice — all remotely, so the flight is for the decision, not the reconnaissance.

That gap is where Vesteri lives. We exist to make buying property abroad feel ordinary: you can check who you are talking to, view a property live without flying across Europe, and get information you can rely on before you commit.
why.closing: We believe in what we are building for a simple reason: this is how we would want to buy.
